question: Q-E1
claim: JUCE 9.0.3's docs/Linux Dependencies.md lists these Ubuntu packages: libasound2-dev, libjack-jackd2-dev, ladspa-sdk, libcurl4-openssl-dev, libfreetype-dev, libfontconfig1-dev, libx11-dev, libxcomposite-dev, libxcursor-dev, libxext-dev, libxinerama-dev, libxrandr-dev, libxrender-dev, libxi-dev, libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev, libglu1-mesa-dev, mesa-common-dev, libegl-dev.
notes:
Compiler: clang or g++.
juce_audio_devices: libasound2-dev; libjack-jackd2-dev (unless JUCE_JACK=0)
juce_audio_processors: ladspa-sdk (unless JUCE_PLUGINHOST_LADSPA=0)
juce_core: libcurl4-openssl-dev (unless JUCE_USE_CURL=0)
juce_graphics: libfontconfig1-dev (unless JUCE_USE_FONTCONFIG=0); libfreetype-dev (unless JUCE_USE_FREETYPE=0; libfreetype6-dev as fallback name)
juce_gui_basics: libx11-dev libxcomposite-dev libxcursor-dev libxext-dev libxinerama-dev libxrandr-dev libxrender-dev libxi-dev (each Xcursor/Xinerama/Xrandr/Xrender/Xinput unless the matching JUCE_USE_X*=0)
juce_gui_extra: libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev (unless JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0; libwebkit2gtk-4.0-dev on older systems)
juce_opengl: libglu1-mesa-dev mesa-common-dev libegl-dev
Full command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install libasound2-dev libjack-jackd2-dev ladspa-sdk libcurl4-openssl-dev libfreetype-dev libfontconfig1-dev libx11-dev libxcomposite-dev libxcursor-dev libxext-dev libxinerama-dev libxrandr-dev libxrender-dev libxi-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libglu1-mesa-dev mesa-common-dev libegl-dev
New vs older JUCE: libegl-dev is required because JUCE 9 uses EGL rather than GLX for OpenGL contexts on Linux (BREAKING_CHANGES.md, Version 9.0.0, 'JUCE now uses EGL'). Doc states it was tested on Ubuntu 16.04-20.04 and that libfreetype-dev/libfontconfig1-dev are available on Ubuntu 22/24. A plugin that sets JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0 (NEEDS_WEB_BROWSER defaults to not linking WebKit per CMake API.md line 427) can drop libwebkit2gtk; if not using juce_opengl, GL packages can be dropped.

question: Q-E3
claim: pluginval v1.0.4 CLI sets strictness with --strictness-level [1-10] (default 5, clamped to 1..10; 5 is the recommended minimum for host compatibility).

question: Q-E5
claim: Whether `auval` is present on macos-15 images could not be confirmed from the runner-images repo: neither the macos-15-arm64 readme nor the macos build scripts mention auval.
notes: auval is Apple's /usr/bin/auval, shipped with macOS (AudioToolbox) rather than installed by the image scripts, so it is expected to exist on any macOS GitHub runner; however this is an inference, not verified, and AU validation on a headless runner may need the component registered (copy to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components) and the audio component registry refreshed. Recommend a `which auval; auval -h` smoke step in the first CI run. GitHub code search API returned HTTP 500 so a repo-wide grep was not possible; I grepped the git tree paths and readmes only. macOS runner readme lists an 'install-audiodevice.sh' script (audio device tooling), unrelated to auval.

question: Q-E9
claim: In JUCE 9.0.3 the AudioProcessor class lives in the headless module at modules/juce_audio_processors_headless/processors/juce_AudioProcessor.h/.cpp, while AudioProcessorEditor (which needs GUI) stays in modules/juce_audio_processors/processors/juce_AudioProcessorEditor.h/.cpp.
notes: A processor-only unit test (no editor) can therefore link just juce_audio_processors_headless (dependencies: juce_audio_basics, juce_events; no juce_graphics since 8.0.9 per BREAKING_CHANGES.md 'AudioProcessor::TrackProperties::colour removed'), avoiding X11/freetype entirely on Linux. Testing the editor needs juce_audio_processors (-> juce_gui_extra -> juce_gui_basics -> X11 on Linux).

question: Q-E9
claim: juce::ScopedJuceInitialiser_GUI (declared in modules/juce_events/messages/juce_Initialisation.h, defined in modules/juce_events/messages/juce_MessageManager.cpp lines 531-550) just calls initialiseJuce_GUI() = MessageManager::getInstance() on the first instance and shutdownJuce_GUI() = MessageManager::deleteInstance() on the last, and is documented for use at the start of a console app's main().
notes: Doc comment warns to create/delete these on the message thread. Typical test main(): `juce::ScopedJuceInitialiser_GUI init;` then run Catch2 session (or a custom main in Catch2 with a test-listener). MessageManager::runDispatchLoopUntil(ms) (juce_MessageManager.h:180, only if JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED) can be used to pump async/timer messages in tests; MessageManager::setCurrentThreadAsMessageThread() (juce_MessageManager.h:274) designates the test thread as the message thread.

question: Q-E9
claim: docs/CMake API.md at 9.0.3 is byte-identical to the one at 8.0.15, and relative to 8.0.12 it only adds optional juce_add_plugin/juce_add_gui_app arguments (ICON_COMPOSER_BUNDLE, LV2_PLUGIN_CLASS) plus clarifications on AU_SANDBOX_SAFE; no new required juce_add_plugin arguments, and nothing about the headless split.
notes: Obtained both files via contents API and ran cmp/diff: 9.0.3 vs 8.0.15 identical (48503 bytes); 8.0.12 vs 9.0.3 differ by +ICON_COMPOSER_BUNDLE (Xcode 26 Icon Composer bundle, optional), +LV2_PLUGIN_CLASS (optional; defaults InstrumentPlugin for synths), and notes that AU_SANDBOX_SAFE TRUE makes SUPPRESS_AU_PLIST_RESOURCE_USAGE ineffective. juce_add_plugin <target> [KEY value]... with all keys optional. grep for 'headless' in CMake API.md returns nothing. Standard keys (COMPANY_NAME, PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE, PLUGIN_CODE, FORMATS, IS_SYNTH, NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT, PRODUCT_NAME) unchanged. Caveat: JUCE 9.0.0 release notes mention 'Improved the CMake build system for headless environments' but no corresponding API doc change was found.

question: Q-E9
claim: JUCE 9.0.3 headline changes relevant to a plugin build: EGL replaces GLX for OpenGL on Linux (adds libegl-dev), Drawable no longer inherits from Component and has a new SVG parser, and juce_graphics no longer depends on juce_gui_basics for SVG/Drawable.
notes: 9.0.3 itself (2026-09-28) is a bugfix release: Opus and WebP support, ALSA fixes, SystemStats::isOperatingSystem64Bit() semantics change (BREAKING_CHANGES.md lines 3-30). Code using Drawable as a Component, or the old Drawable::createFromSVG(XmlElement) path, will need migration.
